species.name: Arcadiamon In-Training
species.flavor: Arcadiamon (In-Training) is a Digimon. It is a Digimon artificially created from the data of various Digimon.

species.name: Arcadiamon Champion
species.flavor: Arcadiamon (Champion) is a Mysterious Beast Digimon. A cursed Digimon artificially created from the data of various Digimon.

species.name: ShellNumemon
species.flavor: ShellNumemon is a Crustacean Digimon. It was a Numemon that made use of its intelligence and found a shell to cover itself in order to protect its body.

species.name: Sorcermon
species.flavor: Sorcermon is a Wizard Digimon. It has a form very similar to Wizardmon.

species.name: MudFrigimon
species.flavor: MudFrigimon is a Mutant Digimon. Its body is mostly made of earth data.

species.name: Arcadiamon Ultimate
species.flavor: Arcadiamon (Ultimate) is a Mysterious Beast Digimon. A cursed Digimon artificially created from the data of various Digimon.

species.name: Meteormon
species.flavor: Meteormon is a Rock Digimon. It is a form of Gotsumon which, for some reason, had the meteorite data within the ore data it possesses appear on its surface.

species.name: SkullMeramon
species.flavor: SkullMeramon is a Flame Digimon. A Digivolution of Meramon, its body is surrounded by intensely hot flames.

species.name: Arcadiamon Mega
species.flavor: Arcadiamon (Mega) is a Mysterious Beast Digimon. It is a cursed Digimon artificially created based on the data of various Digimon.

species.name: Goldramon
species.flavor: Goldramon is a Holy Dragon Digimon. One of the "Four Great Dragons", it is a God Dragon Digimon with six hardened wings and a body that shines gold.

species.name: Arcadiamon Ultra
species.flavor: Arcadiamon (Ultra) is a Mysterious Beast Digimon. The form taken when Arcadiamon (Mega) evolved even further when it absorbed energy generated from battles.

species.name: Alphamon (X-Antibody)
species.flavor: Alphamon is a Warrior Digimon and a carrier of the X-Antibody. It is one of the "Royal Knights", and while it is a holy knight, it is said that it is a being to the holy knights, and as it doesn't appear in normal times, it is also called the "Aloof Hermit" who flutters a blue mantle, and is the Royal Knight assigned to the place called the "".

species.name: Crusadermon (X-Antibody)
species.flavor: Crusadermon X is a Holy Warrior Digimon and carrier of the X-Antibody. Wielding the Rose's Pile Bunker, a rose-shaped shield used for both offense and defense, as well as the Rose's Fencer, a rapier, it sports a noble form and has attained even more power befitting of the Lord of Knights.
